tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// gnod sbyin lha mang gi 'khrul 'khor bca' sgrub kyi lag len rnam gsal du bkod pa rin chen rdzing bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

gnod sbyin lha mang gi 'khrul 'khor bcang sgrub kyi lag len rnam gsal du bkod pa rin chen rdzing bu zhes bya ba/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin gzugs skur bzhengs// phongs pa'i 'jigs sel nor bu'i gter// bcom ldan dzam lar gus btud nas// 'khrul 'khor man ngag gsal bkod bya// de'ang 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud dang*/ de'i 'grel pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa dge ba'i 'dod 'jo las gsungs pa'i gnod sbyin yab yum rnams kyi 'khrul 'khor sgrub pa'i tshul bshad pa la gsum/ lugs mang spyir bstan/ lag len bye brag tu bshad/ nyer mkho'i rjes gnang dang bsnyen thabs bkod pa'o// dang po ni/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud le'u gnyis pa nas gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu man ngag dang 'khrul 'khor gyi bya ba de'i dgos pa bcas bstan pa'i dgongs don/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis dge ba'i 'dod 'jor gsal bar bkral ba ltar bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis phyag len cher dar bar mdzad kyang bzhed pa mi mthun pa mang du mchis pa las/ bod gzhung snga shos sa skya rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis 'khor lo pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar gtso bo yab yum sngags 'go rgyab bam nub bstan/ 'dab ma brgyad kyi pho 'khor la phyogs bzhir shar nas ma ṇi bha dra sogs bzhi/ mtshams bzhir byang shar nas ki li mā li sogs bzhi/ gnyis ka'ang g.yon bskor dang*/ mo 'khor la phyogs bzhir shar nas tsan+d+ra kān+t+re sogs bzhi/ mtshams bzhir shar lho nas su bha dra sogs bzhi/ gnyis ka g.yas bskor/ sngags mgo thams cad rgyab tu bstan/ spel tshig rgya gzhung nas dper brjod byung bcug /ma ma dha ni de hi de hi zhes pa tsam swā hā'i gong du bcub/ lugs 'dir mo 'khor gtso bor byas te pho 'khor steng dang mo 'khor mgo dbu rgyab bstan du 'jog /'grel pa lam brten pa'i rgyud rkyang lugs yin kyang skyon bral tshad mar 'dzin cing ngor chen sogs de'i rjes 'brang mdzad/

bu ston zhabs yig mgo phyir bstan sogs de ltar la steng 'khor lho byang go ldog man ngag tu bzhed pa'i dgongs don zhwa lu pa rnams mo 'khor steng du mdzad/ yang bla ma dam pas 'bri lugs spyi khyab grags rgyal bzhed pa ltar la pad 'dab kyi lha sngags rnams kyi dbu nang du bstan/ gtso bo gnyis kyi dbu shar du bstan par bshad/ stag tshang lo tsās 'god tshul spyir thog mar smos pa de ltar la 'khor lo gnyis ka'ang phyogs bzhir shar dang*/ mtshams bzhir shar lho nas mgo brtsams te g.yas bskor kho nas 'god par 'dod cing dbyangs gsal rten snying rdo rwa me ri'ang bsnan/ lnga pa chen pos 'god tshul rje btsun grags pa dang dpal ldan bla ma'i lugs gang rung 'thad par bzhed cing*/ rgyas par yab dgu yum dgu'i sku gdugs kyi thugs kar so so'i sngags bri/ 'bring po sku gzugs med pa'i sngags tsam dang*/ bsdus pa dzaṃ dgu baṃ dgu/ rgyas 'bring gnyis la rdo rwa me ris bskor ba/ spel tshig snga ma de'am/ che ge mo'i nor dang 'bru dang dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol// la sogs pa'i spel tshig sbyar tshul dang*/ rgyud le'u gnyis pa las/ gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor los bris te nor dang 'byor pa sgrub pa'i ched du mo gnyis kha sbyor ram/ pho mo kha sbyar bar gsungs zhes rgyud don drang thad du 'grel nas yab yum sbrags pa'i 'khrul 'khor dang*/ yum rkyang kha sbyar gyi 'khrul 'khor bstan pa'i shugs las yab rkyang kha sbyor yang bstan par bzhed do// thams cad mkhyen pa mi bskyod rgyal ba yab sras kyis bzhed pa ni lugs rnying pa dang mthun la/ khyad par gyi man ngag ni de las lhag pa ste 'og tu bstan par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ spyir rgyud las/ yab yum gnyis med kyi dngos grub blang ba'i thabs su bsnyen pa sngon du 'gro bas sgrub pa dang*/ bsnyen pa med kyang 'khrul 'khor tsam gyis dngos grub blang ba'i thabs gnyis su gsungs pa deng sang phal cher bya sla 'dod chen pa mang bas phyi ma lag len gtsor byas kyang*/

sngags pa rnams la snga ma dang skye bo chos ldan sogs kyi khyim du phyi ma gtsor bton dgos pas 'chad par 'gyur ba'i rjes gnang thob cing bsnyen pa sogs sngon du thems pa'i gang zag gis 'khrul 'khor sgrub cing dngos grub kyi las la sbyor dgos pa ni thams cad la mtshungs so// de la gnyis/ sngar grags kyi yul dang*/ khyad par gyi chan ngag bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ 'khrul 'khor 'bī ba dang sgrub pa thams cad skar ma rgyal la babs pa'i che bya dgos pa 'grel par bshad/ 'khrul 'khor bris gzhi gser dngul rab/ 'bring zangs kyi byang bu gzong ris byas te tsha gser btang ba dang*/ ma 'byor pa'am cha grangs rgya shog la mtshal gyis spar btab kyang rung*/ bkod tshul gong smas rje btsun grags pa'i bzhed pa ltar la/ spel tshig dha na shrī hi shrī bhū ti puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru/ zhes sbyar ba dang*/ rgyab tu mu khyud bzhi'i nang mar dbyangs gsal/ de rgyab rten snying rnams kyang yig mgo phyir bstan g.yas bskor du bkod/ de rgyab rdo rwa dang 'od zer pa tra g.yas skor du bri/ sgrub tshul 'og nas bshad ba'i yab yum sbrags pa'i 'khrul 'khor ltar la/ pho gtso bor bya ba'i lugs yin pas 'jog dus dbu nub bstan mo 'khor steng du 'byung bar bya'o// gnyis pa la gcig /'khor lo bri ba dang*/ sgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ rgyud kyi dngos bstan jo bo chen po'i man ngag dang*/ slob dpon a bha ya'i dgongs pa ltar rje btsun sgrol mgon zhabs kyis pho rkyang mo rkyang pho mo sbrags pa ste 'khor lo gsum bskyed chog lo po'i tshul bcas gsungs pa'i lag lan ni/ rgyud don 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis bkral ba nyid ches tshad mar gyur pas de'i don 'be lo tsā ba tshe dbang kun khyab kyis gsal bar mdzad pa ltar na/ bri gzhi gong smos rab 'bring ngam dar ras la gser dngul khu bas/ mu khyud dang po lte ba gnyis pa pad+ma 'dab brgyad/

gsum pa rdo rje/ bzhi pa me dang bcas pa'i lte bar/ oṃ swā hā/ zhes 'god pa ni yab yum gnyis kar mtshungs/ 'di dbu shar bstan du bshad pa don la 'gal ba med kyang rnam pa mi bde bas snga ma rnams kyis dgag sgrub mang ba'i phyir nub bstan byas na rung*/ yum 'khor la shar nas g.yon bskor du/ oṃ paṃ suṃ dhāṃ riṃ ṇiṃ swāṃ hāṃ/ zhes yig mgo nang bstan dang*/ yab 'khor la shar nas g.yas bskor du/ dzamra/ bham̐ lam̐ dza lenram̐ dram̐ swām̐ hām̐/ zhes mgo phyir bstan tu bkod/ thams cad la'ang lte ba bzhin tu/ oṃ dang swā hā sbyang zhing zla tshes thig le nā da dang bcas pa bya ba ni yab yum sbrags pa'i 'khrul 'khor yin la/ yum rkyang kha sbyor la steng 'khor gong smos dang 'og 'khor yig mgo phyir bstan g.yas bskor/ yab rkyang kha sbyor la 'og 'khor gong smos dang steng 'khor yig mgo nang bstan du byas pas 'grub bo// 'dir yum rkyang kha sbyor rgyud nas dngos su gsungs pa la'ang dgos pa med par sngon gyi mkhas pa kha cig gis bshad pa de dag man ngag dang bral ba'i rtog ge rnal par 'khyams pa ste rjes su 'brang bar mi bya bar lnga pa chen pos gsungs pa dang*/ lugs 'di ni gshin rje gshed sogs 'khrul 'khor spyi'i lugs yin par ma zad rgyud 'grel man ngag brgyud pa dang bcas pa zhal mthun pa gtsigs su bzung bar 'os so// 'dir rdo rwa me ri 'bri ba'ang gsang ba spyi'i lugs yin pa dang dge ba'i 'dod 'jor me'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par gsungs pa'i rigs pas nges par grub bo// gnyis pa ni/ spyir rje btsun grags pa'i rjes 'brang byed na rab gnas dpal 'byor rgya mtsho las bshad pa bzhin bsgrub dgos pa yin cing*/ de'ang sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i dzaṃ la'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa las/ dpal ldan mgon po dzaṃ bha la// nor rgyun ma la 'khyud pa dang*// zhes 'byung ba dang rgyud las mo 'khor gsungs pa'i don dang 'byor pa yin la/

skabs 'dir rje btsun sgrol mgon zhabs kyis lha mang rjes gnang gi skabs su/ 'ga' zhig 'di dang gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i lag len gnyis kar sa skya pa dang*/ bka' gdams pa rnams lag len tu byed mnyam yin yang*/ jo bo rje nas la brgyud pa ni ma yin gyi/ ba ri lo tsā ba'i man ngag sa skya pa'i lag len de bka' gdams pas brkus nas/ jo bo rje la kha daphang ba'o// zhes zer ba ni/ sa skya pa'i pho rus la bsam pa'i bab col te/ 'di nyid kyi rgyud bsgyur ba bo'i paṇ+ḍi ta yang jo bo rje kho na las gzhan med pa'i phyir/ jo bo rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i lag len du 'byung ba ni/ chos bdag po'i tshul yin la/ de las brgyud nas rje btsun sa skya pa rnams las 'ongs ba ste/ brjod pa snga ma de g.yem ma mu cor gyis rgyal lo// zhes pa dang mtshungs so// zhes gsungs pa'i jo bo'i lugs rnying par yab gtso bo mdzad pa ltar rje mi bskyod zhabs sogs kyang de bzhin tu bzhed pa ni yab yum go rim mi 'khrugs shing sngags spyi skad dang 'brel ba'i legs bshad du rgyal dbang lnga pas kyang bsngags par mdzad do// des na lugs de ltar nyams su blang ba la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos bzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po 'khor lo rab tu gnas pa ni/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa bcas sngon du 'gro bas/ bris pa'i 'khor lo rnams la sbyang ba bya zhing gu gul gyis bdug /rnam 'joms kyi gsungs sogs kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i bum pas khrus gsol/ stegs bzang por 'bru dkar gcal du bkram pa la bkod de/ oṃ swa bhā ba sogs kyis/ 'khor lo mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rma byas btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hrīḥlas pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/

de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sā mā dzaḥs spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan drangs/ ār+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis/ dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gis dbur brgyan par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'dod chags rdo rje chos kyi sku// kun rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid// ting 'dzin chen po'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la'o// zhes bstod/ 'od dpag med zhu ba las byung ba'i 'khor lor bsams la/ 'khor lo'i sngags rnams ci nus dang rten snying brgya la sogs mang du bzla zhing me tog 'thor zhing shis pa brjod/ de nas bri gzhi rin po che'i byang bu yin na dri bzang rin chen phye ma dang*/ pho 'khor la thabs kyi rdzas mar/ mo 'khor la shes rab kyi rdzas sbrang dang ka ra rnams sbyar bas 'khor lo gnyis ka'i lha gnas rnams su thig le bya/ shog gu yin na/ dri bzang sogs lte ba dang mar sbrang gyis mtha' nas cung zad bskus te/ yab yum rkyang pa dang sprags ma so sor kha sbyar te dar ser po'i na bzas klubs/ skud seb gyis rgya gram du nub par bcing*/ gsum ka'ang dbus kyi yig mjug mdun/ rkyang pa gnyis steng 'khor 'og 'khor ma nor ba de yab yum sbrags ma la mo steng pho 'og tu byas pa'i mtshan ma skud lhag steng ngos su mdud pa bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ stegs bu gru bzhi dang ser pos bkab pa'i khar rin po che'i snod gtsang ma dkar mngar 'bru sogs kyis bkang ba'i dbus su gong gi yab yum sbrags pa'i 'khrul 'khor dbus/

yab rkyang g.yas/ yum rkyang g.yon tu bzhag /steng du dar ser po'i gur phug /mdun tu gtor zlum dkar dmar kha zas kyis spungs pa dang chu gnyis nyer spyod bsham/ sgrub pa po kha byang du phyogs te dkyil 'khor dar zhal sprod du 'khod la/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog sogs skyabs sems lan gsum sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drang*/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don kun bsgrub bya'i phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron tu gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / ces pa'i rgyun bshags bya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa tshogs zhing rnams rang la bstim/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ bdag bskyed gang yang rung bas chog kyang 'dir 'brel chags pa'i dbang gis phyag rdor zhi ba byed na/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po nam mkha'i mdangs can/ zhi zhing 'dzum la 'gying bag dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i prog zhu gsol pa/ mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbur brgyan pa/

phyag g.yas pas thugs kar 'bar ba'i rdo rje gsor ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing g.yon gdan la brten pa/ na bza' mchog dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rab tu bzhad cing rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can no// de'i drung du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sngo sangs khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs shing dgra s+t+wa 'dzin pa'o// rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs kar zla ba la sngags kyi phreng ba gsal bar gyur/ na mo badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā badz+ra pra tiṣ+ṭhi tā ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta sha rī raṃ ān+targa tā ya/ badz+ra sha rī raṃ/ ma ku ru badz+ra a dhiṣ+ṭha na swā hā/ zhes bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ gnas yo byin rlabs ni/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swā bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūṃ las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa'i dbus su/ a las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ las mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi rol mo lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha'i khams gang bar

bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ nas shab+da 'i bar dang*/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ de nas mdun bskyed la lnga/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa/ ye shes pa bstim pa/ mchod bstod/ bzlas pa/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba'o// dang po ni/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su/ paṃ las gser gyi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i lte bar zla ba la dzaṃ yig gser gyi mdog can las skyes pa'i bcom ldan 'das dzam+bha la gser gyi mdog lta bu thung zhing lto ba 'phyang ba rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i phyag dag gis na ku le dang bī dza pū ra ka bsnams pa/ ut+pa la'i phreng bas do shal mdzad pa/ de'i pang du paṃ las skyes pa'i nor rgyun ma sor mos 'khyud pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la zla ba la gnas pa'i shar du dzaṃm las nor bu bzang po la oṃ las skyes ba'i zla shel mas 'khyud pa/ lho ru laṃ las gang ba bzang po la suṃ mra las skyes pa'i sbyin mas 'khyud pa/ nub tu lenram̐ yig las nor sbyin la riṃ las byung ba'i sbyin bzang mas 'khyud pa/ byang du swāṃ las rnam thos sras la swā las skyes pa'i 'phags mas 'khyud pa/ shar lhor bhaṃ las skyes pa'i rol pa'i phreng can dang*/ paṃ las skyes pa'i rab bzang ma brtse ba/ lho nub tu dzaṃ las ma ne 'khyil pa la dhaṃ las skyes pa'i sbas mas 'khyud pa/ nub byang du draṃ las zhal gyi dbang po la ṇiṃ las skyes pa'i lha'i bud med kyis 'khyud pa/ byang shar du hā las skyes pa'i spyod pa'i dbang po la hā las skyes pa'i mtsho ldan mas 'khyud pa/ yab yum de rnams sku mdog gser btso ma ltar rab tu 'bar ba/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ yab rnams gsus pa 'phyang zhing rol pa'i stabs kyis nor bu 'bar ba skyugs pa'i gter gyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na bī dza pū ra ka dang g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/

yum rnams g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na pi dza pū ra ka dang g.yon 'bras gyi snye ma bsnams pa/ bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gying ba/ de dag gi g.yas phyogs su paṃ las gser gyi 'dab ma brgyad pa de'i lte bar zla ba la dzaṃ yig gser gyi mdog can las skyes pa'i dzaṃ lha la gser gyi mdog lta bu thung zhing lto ba 'phyang ba rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i phyag dag gis na ku la dang bī dza pū ra ka bsnams pa/ ut+pa la'i phreng bas do shal mdzad pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la zla ba la gnas pa'i shar du dzaṃm las nor bu bzang po/ lhor laṃ las gang ba bzang po/ nub tu lenam̐ las nor sbyin/ byang du swāṃ las rnam thos sras/ shar lhor bhaṃ las rol pa'i phreng can/ lho nub tu dzaṃ las ma ne 'khyil pa/ nub byang du draṃ las zhal gyi dbang po/ byang shar du hāṃ las spyod pa'i dbang po rnams sku mdog gser btso ma ltar 'bar ba dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gsus pa 'phyang zhing rol pa'i stabs kyis gter gyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na bī dza pū ra ka dang*/ g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ g.yon phyogs su paṃ las gser gyi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa de'i lte bar zla ba la paṃ yig gser gyi mdog can las skyes pa'i nor rgyun ma gser gyi mdog can/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du aṃ las zla shel ma/ lho ru suṃ las sbyin ma/ nub tu riṃ las sbyin bzang ma/ byang du swāṃ las 'phags ma/ shar lhor bhaṃ las rab bzang ma/ lho nub tu dhāṃ las sbas ma/ nub byang du ṇiṃ las lha'i bud med/ byang shar du hāṃ las mcho ldan ma rnams sku mdog gser btso ma ltar rab tu 'bar ba/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis rab tu brgyan pa/ rol pad stabs kyis nor bu 'bar ba skyugs pa'i gter gyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ g.yas kyi mchog sbyin gyi mthil na bī dza pū ra ka dang*/

g.yon thugs kar 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gying ba/ 'di ni 'khrul 'khor gsum po dkyus gcig tu sgrub pa stabs bde ba dang*/ rjes gnang la'ang 'di ltar bskyed dgos pas bkod pa yin gyi/ so sor bsgrub par spro na thog mar yab yum sbrags ma dang*/ de nas srung 'khor gyi dbus su zhes pa'i 'phros/ yab rkyang dang yum rkyang so sor sbyar ba dang mchod bstod sogs la'ang rnam dbye phyes par bya'o// thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ dang rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la yab yum la gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pa d+yaṃ sogs/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañca gu la sa pa ri wā ra sbyar ba'i/ ār+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ shrī ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las thams cad la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ gsum pa ni/ thal mo sbyar te/ 'jig rten khams 'di'am dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// nor lha 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod// oṃ ba su de ba maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐/

zhes dang*/ de bzhin tu/ zhabs bsil dang*/ me tog sogs nas/ rol mo 'i bar 'don pa bsgyur la dbul zhing*/ dharma ra ṇi ta sogs brjod/ spro na/ rtsibs stong ldan pa'i gser gyi 'khor lo sogs// rgya chen bsod nams dpal las legs grub pa// mi yi dbang po'i rin chen sna bdun 'bul// bzhes nas dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// sngags mgo sngar ltar la/ sap+ta rat+na pū dzi te hūm̐/ g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa'i ral gri sogs// bsod nams du ma'i mthu yis legs bskyed pa'i// sa bdag nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun 'bul// bzhes nas dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// sngags mthar/ sap+ta u pa rat+na pū dzi te hūm̐/ yid 'ong gzugs dang rna bar snyan sgra sogs// bsod nams du ma'i mthu yis legs bskyed pa'i// mtho ris 'gro ba'i 'dod yon rnam lnga 'bul// bzhes nas dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i= sngags mthar/ pañca kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐/ thub pas byin brlabs me long sogs dang ni// sku yi cha shas dbyibs mtshon dpal be'u sogs// bkra shis sgrub pa'i rdzas dang rtags brgyad 'bul// bzhes nas dpal 'byor= sngags mthar/ maṅga laṃ āṣ+ṭa dra bya tsih+na pū dzi te hūm̐// zhes pa'i sngags rnams la nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bya zhing mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pa// tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes nas// sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'bebs pa'i// nor sbyin yab yum 'khor dang bcas la bstod// 'gro la dmigs med thugs rje yis// thabs mkhas rang bzhin sku sprul pa// gnod sbyin pho mo'i tshogs rnams la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// ces spyir bstod/ bye brag tu/ spro na dzaṃ bha la'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa dang*/ dzaṃ lha'i bstod pa ni/ lha dang lha min dri za mi'am ci rnams kyi// cod pan 'od kyis zhabs kyi 'khri shing gsal mdzad pa// byang chub mchog tu nges mdzad gnod sbyin dbang phyug la// sems can rnams la sman pa'i bsam pas bdag gis gsol// gang zhig brtse ba'i bdag nyid byang chub sbyin mdzod khyod// snying rje'i brtse ba sems can don tu rab tu grags// mgon khyod sems can rnams la brtse ba mi mdzad na// khyod kyis sangs rgyas dran par gang gis gyur te 'tshal// shin tu mi bzad dbul ba'i sdug bsngal nang du ni// 'gro rnams lhung ba khyod kyis mthong bar ma gyur tam// rin chen gter chen rnams kyi mtshan nas bzung nas kyang*// khyod kyi chu bo yang ni rdzing gis bcing par mdzod// shin tu dbul ba'i byin za mi bzad drag po yis// 'gro ba gang zhig nyin dang mtshan du sreg par byed// brtse ba nyid kyis ser sna rnam par spongs mdzod la// rin chen bdud rtsi'i char gyi char rgyun drag tu phob// khyod ni dgod pas brgya byin gyi ni rgyal srid dang*// spyan zur tsam gyis khyab mjug gi ni dpal mo dang*// mnyes pas dbang phyug gi ni gangs ri'i gnas kyang thob// mgon po sdug phongs mgron bu tsam yang mi ster ram// 'gro ba'i dbang phyug rnams la dpag med bde ba rnams// rtag tu khyod ster sdug bsngal can la de ltar min// khyod kyis sngon ma mthong ba'i snying rje'i yul gyur pa'i// dbul ba'i sdug bsngal can la ji ltar khyod 'jigs sam// nor gyis nor slong gus ldan rnams la khyod 'gengs kyi// yi dwags skal med sdig byas rnams la khyod min zhing*// nor gtong nor gyi nor ldan phal ni 'dzin gyur te// mgon po slong ba'i tshogs ni nges par spong byed dam// gal te khyod kyis nor gtong rnams la khyod kyis ster// skye bo tshogs ngan rnams la ji ltar khyod 'jigs sam// rab tu 'bad pas nges par smra ba de yis mchog

/gnod sbyin rgyal po bdag gis gsol ba gsan tu gsol// rab tu 'bad byas de 'dra'i nor dang ldan gyur na// ji ltar dbul ba'i sgra ni thos par ma gyur cig /dbul po'i me ni rab tu 'bar bas 'gro ba rnams// sreg par ngas mthong yid kyis ngo mtshar nyid du gyur// gang zhig bdag gis smras pa'i tshig rtsub tshig rnams ni// chu yi dbang pos brtse phyir 'di rnams bzod par mdzod// gang zhig bstod pa 'di yis ni// rtag tu 'bad pas dzaṃ lar bstod// des ni dbul por mi 'gyur zhing*// shin tu mi g.yo'i dpal thob shog / mi dbang nyi ma rnam gnon gyis mdzad pa'o// nor rgyun ma'i bstod pa ni/ kye ma bum pa rin chen gter ldan steng*// de steng skyon bral nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la// gdod nas dag pas sku mdog gser lta bu// ma bcos rang bzhin byis pa'i gzugs 'dra ba// snyan mgur phyag zhabs rin chen phreng bas brgyan// zla rgyas ltar mdzes 'phags ma'i sku la 'dud// brtse ldan sbyin pa grub pa'i tshul mnga' ba// pad+ma'i zhal mnga' 'gag med seng ge'i sgras// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus sel byed ma// dpal ldan lha mo khyod 'dra'i gsung la 'dud// tshogs gnyis mthar phyin sa bcu rim bsgrod nas// thugs rje'i dbang gis sems can re 'dod bskang*// spros pa'i mtha' bral bde ba chen po'i ngang*// yang dag don rtogs lha mo'i thugs la 'dud// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin bī dza pha la yis// 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs 'gro rnams dbang du sdus// dbul pa sel zhing log 'dren 'joms mdzad pa// g.yon pa thugs kar rin chen snye ma 'dzin// dgos 'dod re skong dpag bsam shing lta bu// yid bzhin nor 'dra khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud// bdag gis khyod la rtag tu mchod byed cing*// gus dang bcas pa'i sems kyis rab bstod na// gdong la mchi mas rab tu gos gyur kyang*// dbul ba'i sdug bsngal skad cig ma 'dor na// sngon gyi thugs rje'i smon lam gang du thal// las kyi 'phro min sbyin shugs zad pa yis// phun sum tshogs pa'i skal pa med gyur kyang*// tshe 'dir phongs pas log 'tsho spong tsam gyi// thugs rje'i thigs pa 'ga' tsam cis mi sbyin// dus 'di nas bzung tshe rabs thams cad du// 'phags ma nor rgyun ma la mchod byed cing*// theg chen gsang sngags chos la spyod pa dang*// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' nyan cing*// dbyer med phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs shog

/rta dang glang po rin chen gos rnams dang*// khrus kyi rdzing bu rin chen bang mdzod dang*// 'dod 'jo ba dang ma rmos 'khrungs rnams la// rtag tu chos dang ldan pa'i longs spyod shog / paṇ+ḍi ta dza mā ri pas mdzad pa'o// de dag mi nus pa'am/ bsdus pa'i skabs su/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*// gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje// byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzaṃ bha la// dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas yab rkyang dang*/ dpal mo dbyig gi char 'bebs nor rgyun ma// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas mdzad cing*// 'gro la phun tshogs ma lus rtsol mdzad ma// lha mo nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces yum rkyang la bstod/ bzhi pa ni/ 'khor lo'i skud sne la btags pa'i gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags phreng ser po gzungs thag la brten te slong*/ 'khor lo'i lha yi thugs kar phog pas rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas 'od zer ser po 'phros pa sbyin bdag gis gtsor byas sems can thams cad la phog /tshe dang bsod nams 'khor dang longs spyod rgyas par byas/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa spyan drangs// 'khor lo yon bdag dang bcas pa la thim par gyur/ ces pas dmigs pa rtse gcig pas/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza len+d+ra ya swā hā/ zhes ci nus dang*/ oṃ ma ṇi bha drā ya swā hā/ oṃ pūr+ṇa bha drā ya swā hā/ oṃ bhan dā ya swā hā/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā/ oṃ ki li mā li ne swā hā/ oṃ tsi pi kuṇ+ḍa li ne swā hā/ oṃ mu khen+d+rā ye swā hā/ oṃ tsa r+yen+d+rā ya swā hā// zhes pa rnams gtso bo'i bcu cha re bzla/ oṃ ba su dhā ri ṇ+yai swā hā/ zhes ci nus dang*/ oṃ tsan+d+rā kā+en+ta yai swā hā/ oṃ dat+ta yai swā hā/

oṃ su dat+tā yai swā hā/ oṃ ār+ya yai swā hā/ oṃ su bha drā ye swā hā/ oṃ gu p+tā yai swā hā/ oṃ de w+yai swā hā/ oṃ sa ra swa t+yai swā hā// zhes pa rnams gtso bo'i bcu cha re bzlas pa'i mthar chu sbyin ni/ zangs gzhong mdun tu bzhag /chu gtsang sta gon byas la/ rgyas par spro na/ gdan pad+ma bskyed pa nas dbang bskur rgyas gdab yan gong ltar la/ bsdu na/ zangs gzhong yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gser gyi pad+ma dang gter gyi bum pa'i gdan dgu tshom gyi steng du gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu thams cad kyang gser gyi mdog can dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa// yab rnams g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na bī dza pū ra ka dang*/ g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ yum rnams g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na bī dza pū ra ka dang*/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa/ gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa badz+ra sā ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang dbang gi lha spyan drangs te/ dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /spyi bor rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rgyas btab par gyur/ rang gi lag mthil zla ba'i steng*// buṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūm̐ yig las// byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa lnga// zhu ba'i bdud rtsi phul bar bsam/ oṃ dzaṃlu swā hā//

zhes dang*/ gong gi sngags rnams kyis chu dbul/ ār+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ gang sngon sbyin pa sogs kyi mthar/ ser sna'i las kyi me yis gdung ba rnams// skye dang skye bar khyod la gsol 'debs kyis// rin chen gter gyi bdud rtsi'i char rgyun gyis// sems can dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod// dzaṃ sid+dhi pha la a la la hoḥ chu thigs myang zhing gtor/ ye shes pa rten la gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par gyur/ de nas gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur// nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs la gtso 'khor rnams kyi sngags la a ka ro btags pa 'dun bdun gyis phul mthar/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te dzaṃ bha la dza len+d+rā ya ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa tā ye/ i maṃ ba liṃ pra tīts+tsha sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hūm̐ badz+ra dza phaṭa swā hā/ ma ma hi ra ṇ+ya su bar+ṇaṇa ma ṇi muk+ta rat+na he ma ni dhī nāṃ/ de hi māṃ/ dzaṃ ghān+tu*/ pi ban+tu/ khā dan+tu/ ma ma shīn+taṃ/ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru badz+ra dha ri ka ba liṃ pra tīts+tsha sa ma ya ma nu sma ra dzaṃ dzaṃ dzaṃ hūm̐ dzuṃ dzi dza phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de nas mchod pa kha gso byin brlabs la/ tshigs bcad dang bcas pa'am sngags tsam gyis mchod/ bstod pa mdor bsdus bya/ 'dod gsol cung zad spro na/ mchod sbyin brgya pa me lha gdong bzhi dang*// seng ge 'phrog byed nyin mor byed rnams kyis// zhabs gnyis la btud bcom ldan sdug bsngal ba// bdag la pad ltar yangs pa'i spyan ras gzigs// bcom ldan chab 'khyor gang gis mnyes gyur na// thugs rje mnga' ba gzhan gang lags par gsungs// de phyir mchod pa bshams la mi rtsi zhing*// khyod dang 'dra ba srid 'dir rnyed par dka'// brtse bas 'bad pa'i sgo nas btsal btsal nas// phongs par gyur pa bdag la bde mdzad na// kho bo mchi ma dag gis gdong sbags pa// spyan sngar mchis kyang ci ste gzigs ma lags// e ma ho rab tu rgyas pa'i thugs rje yi// gzhu mo mnga' ba khyod ltar bzhugs gyur kyang*// skye tshogs zlog dka' sdug bsngal chom rkun gyi// sde yis rnam par 'joms pa ji ltar lags// sems can smin slad nor bu rin po che// rnam pa sna tshogs dgung char 'bebs grags na// kho bo khyod nyid gcig pu'i mthar thug pa// ci ste thigs pa yang ni 'bebs ma lags// khyod bzhugs bzhin du me yis 'bar ba ltar// kho bo phongs pas shin tu cher bsregs na// khyod kyi lta zhig thugs rje 'jo ba'i ba// sa gsum khur du khur ba gang du thal// bum pa dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin gyi// nor bu sems pa dang ldan ma lags pa// de dag gis kyang sems can phan bgyid na// thugs rjes bdag can bcom ldan smos ci 'tshal// gang zhig rmugs 'dzin chu yi dbang po zhes// skad cig kyang ni khyod kyi mtshan smos pa// pad+ma'i 'byung gnas kyis ni pad tshal bzhin// de yis phun sum tshogs pa rgyas par 'gyur// de ltar bcom ldan srid 'joms khyod spyan sngar// cho nges btab pa'i bsod nams 'byams klas pa// gang yin de yis skye bo khyod bzhin du// mngon par mtho ba'i 'bras bu 'phyin par shog

/ ces pa slob dpon chen po btsun pa zla bas mdzad pa'o// mi nus na/ nor lha 'khor dang bcas pas sbyin pa'i bdag pos gtsor byas sems can thams cad kyi zas nor longs spyod thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ me tog gtor/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ de nas me tog ser po thogs la/ bcom ldan 'das nor gyi dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa khyod rnams rten 'di rnams la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas rten 'di gang du bzhugs pa'i yul phyogs dang gnas khang thams cad du lo phyugs legs shing 'bru bcud dar ba dang*/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rgya mtsho chen po la chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ lha rnams 'od du zhu nas bris pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi yi ge dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su gyur/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha dang*/ ye dharma mang du brjod cing me tog 'thor/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po zhes gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /nor gyi dbang phyug 'grub gyur nas// sogs dang*/ thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin du// longs spyod zad pa med par shog /rtsod pa med cing 'tshe med pa// rang dbang du ni spyod par shog /lha yang dus su char 'bebs shing*// lo tog phun sum tshogs par shog /rgyal po chos bzhin byed pa dang*// 'jig rten dag kyang dar bar shog /'bad dang rtsol bas mi gos pa// yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam bzhin// sems can re ba skong mdzad pa// bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ces sogs bsngo smon shis brjod khyad par ba dang*/ gzhan yang*/ che ba'i che mchog ston mchog sogs mdo rgyud nas 'byung ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rgya cher brjod/ de lta bu thun du bcad nas rang ngam sbyin bdag sogs la rmis ltas dge ba lta bu'i rtags ma byung gi bar ram zhag bdun sogs su bsgrub bo// 'grub tu rung na sngags rgyun kyang bya ste gong ma rnams kyi de ltar mdzad pa'i tshul lo rgyus rnams su gsal lo// gsum pa ni/

sgrub pa zin pa'i 'khrul 'khor rgyud kyi dgongs pa ltar na bang mdzod kyi phug lta bur za ma tog chen po'i nang du bzhag /zhun mar sbrang rtsi ka ra rnams kyis nub par byas la nyin re bzhin dri bzang gi chu/ spos me tog sogs mchod par bya ste/ de'ang dper na/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza len+d+ra gan+dhaṃ pa tīts+tsha na maḥ zhes sogs lta bu'o// yang na 'khrul 'khor de nyi ma re rer zangs gzhong lta bur spyan drangs nas gur gum gyi chu yi chu sbyin 'bul bar byas na/ grub pa chen po brgyad kyang ster na dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos gsungs pa dang*/ mtho ris yon tan bdun gyi dpal rnams bde blag tu 'grub pa sogs rgyud dang 'grel pa las gsungs so// da lta phyag len gtso bor rten la gzhug pa'i dbang du byas na/ rgyud sde rnams las bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i rnam 'gyur du gsungs pas dregs pa rang rgyud pa'i 'og seng khri lta bur bzhugs mi rung zhing*/ pad gdan du gdong chen rnams su chos skyong gi rten dang mdun rgyab tu bzhag /de'ang sgrub pa'i skabs ltar yab yum sbrags ma dbus/ yab rkyang g.yas/ yum rkyang g.yon/ lte ba'i dgu rgyab ngos bstan te rten chen po la zhun mar gyi snod du bzhag /che chung gang la'ang de dang mtshams pa'i dkor cha ci 'byor pa dang bcas te bzhugs su gsol lo/ ༈ /lnga pa la gnyis/ rjes gnang dang*/ bsnyen pa bya thabs so// dang po ni/ 'khor lo yod na shin tu legs pas sgrub pa'i skabs ltar dang*/ med na maṇ+ḍal sum bsgrigs steng tshom bu gtso 'khor dgu re bkod/ mchod gtor bsham/ gong smos ltar skyabs sems nas brtsams/ bdag mdun bzlas pa chu sbyin gtor 'bul yan grub nas/ slob ma la chab btang*/ me tog bkye bsdu dang sems bskyed gsal gdab/ de la 'dir sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi rnam 'phrul dpal ldan a ti sha dang nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'ang ma dpal dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i rgyud/

bod snga ma rnams kyis bya rgyud gshegs rigs su bzhed pa de nyid kyi le'u gnyis pa nas gsungs pa'i rmugs 'dzin lha mang gi man ngag rnams grub pa'i dbang phyug dze ta ris jo bo rje nyid la gnang*/ des kyang nag tsho lo tsā ba la gnang nas rim par brgyud pa'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug / thal mo me tog dang bcas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos gsungs shig /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol// lan gsum/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir/ mdun bskyed kyi lha dang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi drung du rgyun bshags dang skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub kyi sems bzung ba la sogs par bgyid snyam pa'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang bla mas dpal gsang ba'i bdag po 'di bzhin du gsal thob cig /oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas/ zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can tu lam gyis gyur pa'i gsal snang la gnas pa dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor yang 'di bzhin du gsal 'debs par zhu/ oṃ swa bhā ba sogs nas yab yum sbrags pa/ yab rkyang*/ yum rkyang*/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ sa bon gyis mtshan pa'o// bar brjod/ zangs gzhong sogs nyer bsdogs chu sbyin bya zhing slob ma rnams la 'bul du gzhug /mthar gtor ma dang mchod bstod kyang bya/ de nas rjes gnang dngos la lung gsum las// dang po rjes su bzlas pa'i lung blang ba'i phyir/ mdun bskyed gtso 'khor rnams kyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'khod/ de'i dus su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par sngags phreng dang lhan cig zhal du zhugs/

snying kha'i sngags phreng la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gsungs shig / snying po rnams lan gsum rjes zlos byar gzhug / dang pos byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du 'dres/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gnyis pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung ni/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig /bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// ces lan gsum / de ltar phul ba'i me tog de nyid slar yang byin gyis brlabs te/ khyed rang gi spyi bor phul bar mos pa mdzod cig /slob dpon gyis me tog gtor zhing*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// brtul zhugs brten par mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams la bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la yab dgu yum dgu'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig /gsum pa dam bca' ba'i lung gi phyir/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la yab yum ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar gyi yi dam du bzung ngo*// bdag thugs kyis ma btang zhig snyam pa'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos gsungs shig /slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag rig pa 'dzin pa 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa dzaṃm+bha la yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa yi dam gyi lhar bzung nas 'di'i gsang sngags nyi ma re re bzhin 'di tsam re 'don par dam bca' lags so// zhes lan gsum brjod/ des bzlas pa'i lung bcas rjes gnang legs par grub pa yin pas sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ gtong rag maṇ+ḍal/ lus 'bul/ dge bsngo spyi ltar bya/ slar mchod khag sos te mchod pa byin brlabs/ mchod bstod man chad rjes rim sgrub thabs ltar la 'khor lo sogs rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang med na gshegs gsol bya'o// gnyis pa bsnyen pa ni/

'khrul 'khor gyi las sgrub pa sngon du bsnyen pa ma song ka med pas de'i tshul dge ba'i 'dod 'jor gsungs pa'i ting nge 'dzin kho na'i 'khrul 'khor sgrub pa nyid nyams su len par bya ste/ skyabs sems tshogs bsags kyi bar gong smos sgrub thabs ltar bya/ de nas gnod sbyin mo dgu'i 'khrul 'khor gyi bsnyen pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ rang nyid skad cig gis dzaṃ bha la gser gyi mdog lta bu thung zhing lto ba 'phyang ba brgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i phyag dag gis na ku le dang bī dza pū ra ka bsnams pa/ ut+pa la'i phreng bas do shal mdzad pa/ gsus pa 'phyang zhing rol pa'i stabs kyis gter dang gser gyi pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i thugs kar raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum nyi ma'i mdog can gyi steng du pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar dzam̐lu/ shar la sogs pa'i 'dab ma la/ oṃ ba su dhā ri ṇi swā hā'i yi ge re re bzhin g.yas bskor du gnas pa gser btso ma'i kha dog can/ nor rgyun ma zla shel ma sogs lha mo brgyad kyi ngo bor gyur/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ yi ge rnams las 'od zer gser gyi kha dog can 'phros/ rang gzhan dbul phongs thams cad zhi nas mngon par mtho ba'i dpal la bkod par bsams la/ oṃ ba su dhā ri ṇ+ye swā hā/ sogs gnod sbyin mo dgu'i sngags rnams bzla/ de'ang spyi tsam du gtso bo la 'bum gsum/ 'khor rnams la de'i bcu cha tsam bzla ba ni phyi ma la'ang shes par bya/ thun mthar/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la nor gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ de rang nyid la thim/ de thugs ka'i 'khor lo la thim/ de'ang thugs srog gtso bo la thim/

de gyen rdzogs su yal/ de spros pa dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid kyi dbyings so// zhes mnyam par bzhag / slar yang skad cig gis lhar gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan par gyur// ces mos la dge ba sngo shis brjod bya/ de nas gnod sbyin pho dgu'i 'khrul 'khor gyi bsnyen pa ni/ gong 'og snga ma ltar la/ thugs kar raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum nyi ma'i mdog can gyi dbus su pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar dzam̐lu/ shar la sogs pa'i 'dab ma la/ dz+riṃ/ bhaṃ/ laṃ/ dzaṃ/ lenram̐/ draṃ/ swāṃ/ hāṃ'i/ yi ge rnams re re bzhin g.yas bskor du gnas pa/ gser btso ma'i kha dog can/ dzaṃ bha la dang*/ nor bu bzang po sogs kyi ngo bor gyur/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ yi ge rnams las 'od zer gser gyi kha dog can 'phros/ rang gzhan gyi dbul phongs thams cad zhi nas mngon par mtho ba'i dpal la bkod par bsams la/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/ sogs bzlas pa bya'o// 'di nyid tshul bzhin 'grub na phyi le 'khrul 'khor sogs la ltos pa med par las dang dngos grub bde blag tu 'grub pa yin no// rab gnas dpal 'byor rgya mtshor bshad pa'i bdag bskyed gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu la brten pa de'ang gsang ba spyi'i cho ga yin pas dkyus mthun 'byung mod/ 'di nyid 'phags zhabs kyis rgyud kyi dgongs pa tshul bzhin tu bkral ba'i don yin pas khyad par du 'phags pa'o// sngon dpe bris bshus kho na min// sngar med rang bzo sbyar ba'ang min// tshad ma'i gzhung las rnyed pa yi// legs bshad gzur gnas mkhas rnams mgu// skye dgu'i phongs pa dgun gyi dus// 'di dge drod kyis spos pa las// phun tshogs sos ka'i skyed tshal bzhin// phyogs ris bral bar rgyas byed shog /ces pa'ang rgyud ngang 'grel pa'i dgongs pa ma 'khrul pa'i man ngag tshad ma gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan du/

gzur gnas dpyod ldan byung na lag len la phan du re ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'am blo gros mtha' yas zhes pa'i ku sā lis dpal kun spungs pa'i yang khrod dga' ba'i tshal du bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// //

༈ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i 'khor lo bri sgrub rab gnas dang bcas pa bzhugs/ oṃ swa sti/ tshogs bdag 'khor lo ni/ dar dmar la gser ras/ rgya shog la rgya mtshal gyis/ mu khyud lnga pa rtsibs brgyad dang bcas pa'i lte bar hūm̐ hrīḥbhūṃ mthar/ gu ga ṇa pa ta ye dā na la ti sa ya ri wā ra puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ gyi mjug tu rgyas pa'i spel tshig 'dod gsol sbyar/ gnyis pa la/ oṃ badz+ra e du sha ma dza ta ga ta pe ta ā kar+ṣa ya dā na pa su ā yuḥpun+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ ga ga ga ga ga rnams kyi mthar spel tshig gsum par rtsibs brgyad la ga bzhi pa la rten 'brel snying po/ lnga pa bkra shis rtags brgyad bri/ de rjes dang ras gtsang ma bting pa'i gzhi'i steng du rin po che'i snod 'bras bus bkang ba'i dar du 'khor lo bzhag slob dpon lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pas sbyang ba gsum sngon du 'gro bas bgegs sprad/ gu gul gyis bdug /maṇ+ḍal zla gam dmar po pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng 'bru snod dang bcas te bzhag /mthar mchod gtor gyis bskor 'byung 'dul lta bu'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las gyur pa'i/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dngas shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ 'khor lo bsang sbyang*/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bai ḍūr+ya'i brag ri brtsegs pa'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ nyi ma'i gdan la byi ba sngon po mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du gaḥyongs su gyur pa las tshogs kyi bdag po sku mdog dmar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ ral pa'i thor cog la rin po che dang me tog gis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pa rnams na/ dgra sta/

mda' chen/ lcags kyu/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ 'phang mdung rnams dang*/ g.yon pa rnams na/ gtun shing*/ gzhu/ kha ṭ+waṃ ga khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ sha chen gyis gang ba'i thod pa/ phub dang gdan brten nas 'dzin pa/ dar gyi sham thabs dang rin po che'i phreng ba can/ zhabs g.yas bskums shing*/ g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas thugs rje chen po'i rnam 'phrul tshogs kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ hūm̐/ rang bzhin dag pa byang shar phyogs mtshams nas// thugs rje chen po tshogs bdag skur sprul pa// mchod cing bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na// thogs pa med par myur du gshegs su gsol// badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ dbang lhas dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ga ṇa pa ti ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes sogs kyis mchod/ spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyod// 'gro rnams dbul phongs sel mdzad nor lhar sprul// dgos 'dod stsol phyir gser gyi khri la bzhugs// nor gyi 'gyur gnas khyod la bdag bstod do// tshogs bdag gi thugs kar nyi mi'i gdan la gaḥyig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'jig rten khams kyi dpal 'byor bkrag mdangs gzi brjid thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ sbyin bdag dang bdag sogs sems can thams cad la thim pas dpal 'byor bkrag mdangs gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥg ṇa hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ gu ga ṇa pa ta ya dā na pa ti sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a du sha ma dza ta ga ta pe ta ā kar+ṣa ya dā na ba su ā yuḥ

pun+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ ga ga ga ga ga zhes ci grub bzla/ yi ge brgya ba brjod/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ ga ṇa pa ti i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum gyis dbul la/ gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ tshogs kyi bdag po sgrub gzhi 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas rten la mchod pa dang*/ sbyin bdag dang bdag sogs sems can thams cad la dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa rgyun mi chad du 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ tshogs kyi bdag po 'od du zhu nas bris pa'i 'khor lo'i rnam par gyur// ces 'od zhu dang*/ brten bzhugs byas la ye dhar brjod cing me tog 'thor ro// shis brjod gang 'os bya/ 'di ni dkyus mthun tsam yin la khyad par gyi lag len ni/ dmar po skor gsum gyi gzhung sogs las shes par bya dgos so// zhes pa'ang nyer mkho'i phyir du gu ṇas mkhas pa'i yig cha lan btus pa dge'o//
